llm_response.reason: The website mimics the identity of a well-known legitimate news outlet (tribunnews.com) but its content is a blend of e-commerce product listings and illegal online gambling promotions. Key scam indicators present: impersonation and spoofing of well known brands, manipulative promotional text (deep discounts, shopping app download, urgency), external navigation for core functions (Live Chat/DAFTAR/LOGIN all redirect to another domain), vague or absent contact details, and the illegality of gambling sites in Indonesia. The site does not provide legitimate business information or customer protections, and appears designed to mislead or defraud Indonesian users.
